title: Sunset Nature Walk
blurb: Join our Rangers for an evening stroll along the Eagle Rock Trail and experience the preserve as day turns into night. Discover how wildlife, plants, and the forest transform at sunset while you enjoy stunning views from one of the preserve's most picturesque trails. The hike covers approximately 3 miles on uneven terrain with about 450 feet of elevation gain. Distance may vary based on conditions and group pace. Appropriate for teens and adults. (We will host a family-friendly version of this program on September 20. Junior Rangers: Trailside First Aid with hands-on activities for ages 5-12.) title: Junior Rangers: Nighttime Creatures
blurb: Join our Rangers for the first program in this fall's Junior Rangers series at Roy's Redwoods! Explore the fascinating world of nocturnal wildlife as we discover how animals adapt to life after dark through hands-on activities, games, and a short, guided walk. Attend all three-monthly Junior Ranger programs this fall to earn your Junior Ranger badge or join us for one or two programs to learn new outdoor skills and spend time with our awesome Rangers. Activities are for children ages 5–12 and their families. No pets are allowed, except for service/companion animals. Dress in layers, wear sturdy shoes, and bring a flashlight or headlamp. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel.…

title: Movie in the Park
blurb: Join us for a fall evening in Point Reyes Station for Movie Night! We will feature a family-friendly movie, popcorn, and more! For information about the movie, please contact us as the date approaches. Appropriate for all ages. Friendly dogs are welcome on a leash. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel. Check the calendar or text/call 415) 209-8999 two hours before the event to confirm the status. Registration is required. Questions: Contact Scott Moller

title: Trailside First Aid Hike
blurb: Join our Rangers for a guided hike to learn practical first-aid skills for the trail. Along the way, we will discuss how to recognize and respond to common outdoor injuries and emergencies, what to include in a basic hiking first-aid kit, and tips for staying safe while recreating outdoors. The hike covers approximately 2 miles on uneven terrain with about 200 feet of elevation gain. Appropriate for teens and adults. (We will host a family-friendly version of this program on October 11. Junior Rangers: Trailside First Aid, including hands-on activities for ages 5-12.) No pets are allowed, except for service/companion animals. Dress in layers, wear sturdy shoes, and bring water. blurb: Come explore the newest addition to King Mountain Preserve on this guided hike! Enjoy stunning 360-degree views, with the San Francisco skyline to the east and Mount Tamalpais to the west. We will provide juice and snacks. Appropriate for all ages. Friendly dogs are welcome on a leash. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel. Check the calendar or call (415) 473-2816 two hours before the event to confirm the status. Registration is required. Questions: Contact Robert Roman

title: Pumpkin Carving (San Rafael)
blurb: Get ready to unleash your creativity and embrace the Halloween spirit with our Rangers! Join us for a fun-filled family pumpkin carving session where you can craft your very own spooky Jack-O-Lantern. Appropriate for all ages. We will provide all carving materials and one pumpkin per family (you are welcome to bring your own). No pets, except for service/companion animals. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel. Check the calendar or text/call (415) 302-1034 two hours before the event to confirm the status. Registration is required. Questions: Contact Heidi Strickfaden

At 7:30 PM, we will embark on an interactive Graveyard Stroll featuring a cast of ghostly characters. Appropriate for all ages. No pets are allowed, except for service/companion animals. Dress in layers and wear sturdy shoes. Adverse weather or poor air quality may cancel. Check the calendar or call (415) 473-2816 two hours before the event to confirm the status. Questions: Contact Gabe Ngarangad
